name: cublas_cublasCdotu_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasCdotu_v2.py. Unconjugated complex64 dot product result = x^T . y over strided vectors (the real baseline falls back to cublasCgemm_v2 internally). _random_tensor does not support complex, so x/y/result are built by gen_inputs as (randn+1j*randn).to(complex64); storage sizes are n*incx / n*incy taken from the test. reference writes the 1-element result in place and returns it. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
